description: How much BZB one address can claim for one posted trading-reward day. Read-only. Get dayId from blazar_daily_rewards.postedDays. Polygon only (chain 137).

dayId.description: UTC day number of the trades = floor(unixSeconds / 86400), e.g. "20773" = 2026-11-16. Get it from blazar_daily_rewards (todayDayId, postedDays[].dayId).
